subject.title: improve(agents): normalized web_search output contract with boundary-owned wrapping

question: Should nonconforming external `web_search` provider payloads remain verbatim-compatible, or must they be serialized into a boundary-wrapped representation or rejected before reaching the model?
rationale: The answer determines the durable security and compatibility contract: preserving arbitrary raw values conflicts with the PR’s stated boundary-owned untrusted-content guarantee, while wrapping or rejecting them changes extension behavior.

options.title: Require a wrapped or rejected raw path
options.body: Keep compatibility only through an explicitly untrusted serialized representation, or reject nonconforming payloads, so provider-originated text cannot bypass the boundary.

options.title: Preserve verbatim raw compatibility
options.body: Retain unknown payloads unchanged and explicitly document that external providers, not the core boundary, own their untrusted-content handling.

recommendation.title: Require a wrapped or rejected raw path
recommendation.body: Keep compatibility only through an explicitly untrusted serialized representation, or reject nonconforming payloads, so provider-originated text cannot bypass the boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent merged output-schema architecture and the current contract proposal.
